---
name: Feature / tool request
about: Suggest a tool to add, or an improvement to the OS or docs
title: "[Request] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What are you asking for?**
- [ ] Add a new tool to the OS
- [ ] Improve/fix an existing tool's setup or docs page
- [ ] Something else about the OS itself
- [ ] Something about the documentation site

**Why does this matter?**
What workflow does this unblock or improve? (e.g. "I had to manually install X to complete a detection-engineering lab that should already be covered.")

**Proposed tool/change (if known)**
Name, link, and category it would fall under (see the 10 categories in the docs) — or leave blank if you just have the problem, not the solution.

**Anything else**
Links, prior art, or context that helps us scope this.
